We apply the distributive law

$$
AC+BC=(A+B)C.
$$

So, we calculate $A+B$ first:

$$
\begin{aligned}A+B & =[\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & -1 \\ 3 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & 5 & 4\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-3 & -6 & 1 \\ -3 & 8 & -2 \\ 0 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =4{I}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}AC+BC & =(A+B)C \\  & =4{I}_{3}C \\  & =4C \\  & =[\begin{aligned}8\sqrt{5} & -4 & 12 \\ 0 & 4\sqrt{3} & 16 \\ -8 & 12 & 20\text{ }\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
